descricao_original: A desmosome (macula adherens) is a symmetrical disc-shaped junction between cells which provides intercellular attachment. This electron micrograph of the epidermis shows two adjacent cells with highly folded plasma membranes that are attached by numerous desmosomes. The attachment plaque of the desmosome is anchored to the cytoskeleton by keratin intermediate filaments. 25,000x
